title: Merge a feature branch and resolve it by stated rules
notes: skill: git merge with rule-based conflict resolution (dependency pins take the numerically higher version, changelog entries in a stated side order, key=value settings with main-wins/feature-owned/delete rules) and a proper two-parent merge commit on main; traps: lines git merges silently but the rules overturn (feature downgrade, owned key changed only on main, changelog appended below old entries), 1.10 vs 1.9 numeric compare, delete-vs-modify, a cleanly merged file that must keep the feature's change (knob); pass_guess_permille: 380
